prediction_on_record: interior - aperture still dominates full - interior, as it does at 10 layers (-24.79 vs -1.25 points); a full - interior that has GROWN instead points at the padded-plane window, whose cell count grows with the absorber while the planes do not move.
window_caveat: the `full` window is the whole padded plane, so its tangential cell count grows with cpml_layers (181 at 10 layers, 241 at 40) even though every plane POSITION is held fixed. The physical interior and the aperture windows do not grow. That is what this arm is here to size.

This per-path default is deprecated (issue #571): pass amplitude_kind='current' (amperes, resolution-independent power — the future default) or amplitude_kind='field' (raw E increment). amplitude_kind becomes required in 1.9 (and 'current' the default in 2.0).
